## Set Up

```{r setup, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

# Set default ggplot theme
theme_set(
  theme_bw() +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", linewidth = 0.5)
    )
)

# some helpful settings
options(
  dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE, 
  readr.show_col_types = FALSE
)

set.seed(2025)
```

```{r}
# source in some helper functions we'll use to prep data 
# build_spectra_mtx() build_spectra_cor_df() filter_spectra()
source("./utils/spectra-helper-functions.R")
```

```{r}
# paths to custom geneset files we're going to use for ORA
geneset_file <- file.path("..", "genesets", "custom-gene-sets.tsv")
msigdb_geneset_file <- file.path("..", "genesets", "msigdb-gene-sets.tsv")
category_file <- file.path("..", "genesets", "gene-set-categories.tsv")
```


```{r}
results_dir <- fs::path("..", "ews-nf-out", "cnmf")

# get all the spectra files
spectra_files <- fs::dir_ls(
  path = results_dir, 
  glob = "*.gene_spectra_score.k_*.dt_*.txt", 
  recurse = TRUE
  )

# extract the unique ID for labeling
unique_ids <- stringr::str_extract(spectra_files, pattern = "SCPCL[0-9]+-SCPCS[0-9]+")
names(spectra_files) <- unique_ids
```

```{r}
# read in and build spectra mtx
spectra_mtx <- build_spectra_mtx(spectra_files)

# get correlations
cor_mtx <- cor(spectra_mtx, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

# create correlation dataframe with info about each spectra
all_cor_df <- build_spectra_cor_df(cor_mtx)
```

```{r}
dist_mtx <- as.dist(1-cor_mtx)
tree <- hclust(dist_mtx, method = "ward.D2")
clusters <- cutree(tree, k = 12)
mp_cluster_list <- split(colnames(spectra_mtx), clusters)
names(mp_cluster_list) <- glue::glue("MP{names(mp_cluster_list)}")

# generate mps 
mp_list <- mp_cluster_list |> 
  purrr::map(\(spectra_list){
    
    mps <- rowMeans(spectra_mtx[, spectra_list, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE) |>
      sort(decreasing = TRUE)
    
  })
```


## Correlation between MPs

```{r}
# combine all mps into a matrix for a heatmap
# get correlation to each other
mp_mtx <- do.call(cbind, mp_list)
mp_cor_matrix <- cor(mp_mtx, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  mp_cor_matrix
)
```

## Sample diversity 

```{r}
mp_df <- mp_cluster_list |> 
  purrr::imap_dfr(\(spectra_list, mp_name) {
    tibble::tibble(
      metaprogram = mp_name,
      spectra = spectra_list
    )
  }) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_id = stringr::word(spectra, 1, sep = "_") |> 
      stringr::word(-1, sep = "-")
  )


mp_prop_df <- mp_df |> 
  dplyr::group_by(metaprogram, sample_id) |>
  # generate one row per mp/sample combination with the total count
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), 
                   .groups = "drop_last") |> 
  # get the frequency of each sample compared to all other samples
  dplyr::mutate(p = n / sum(n),
                num_samples = dplyr::n_distinct(sample_id)
  )

mp_prop_df |> 
  # now the shannon index for each metaprogram 
  dplyr::summarise(
    shannon = -sum(p * log(p)), # entropy
    num_samples = unique(num_samples), # get unique value for printing
    shannon_norm = shannon / log(num_samples)
    ) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(desc(shannon_norm)) |> 
  DT::datatable()
```

```{r}
mp_prop_df <- mp_prop_df |> 
  # ungroup before setting levels otherwise the plot doesn't work
  dplyr::ungroup() |> 
  dplyr::mutate(metaprogram = forcats::fct_reorder(metaprogram, num_samples))

ggplot(mp_prop_df, aes(x = p, y = metaprogram, fill = sample_id)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    y = "Metaprogram",
    x = "Proportion of spectra",
    fill = "Sample"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = palette.colors("alphabet", n=13))
```
